name: Laugh Track
source:
You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever!

We're so happy you've chosen permanent employment. Management has infinite faith in your ability to steer our production team towards our mysterious and important endgame. You'll be guiding four teenagers -- Juno, Cat, Daniel, and Remy -- through the trials and travails of high school life.

Using our patented "Ratings(tm)" system, you'll make decisions that keep them entertainingly unhappy! But not too unhappy, or they'll break. But also not too relaxed, or they'll fight back. We can't have that, no! How will we ever reach syndication if the entire project collapses?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765430/Laugh_Track/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你现在是《朱诺的世界》的首席编剧，这是一部完全正常的情景喜剧，从来没有发生过任何奇怪或可怕的事情！

我们很高兴你选择了永久就业。管理层对你带领我们的制作团队走向神秘而重要的结局的能力充满信心。你将引导四个青少年——朱诺、卡特、丹尼尔和雷米——度过高中生活的考验和痛苦。

使用我们的专利“Ratings(tm)”系统，你将做出让他们不开心的决定！但不要太不高兴，否则他们会崩溃。但也不能太放松，否则他们会反击。我们不能这样，不！如果整个项目崩溃，我们将如何达成联合组织？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765430/Laugh_Track/]Steam[/url]]
